new_source_directions: Use NVIDIA's official May 2026 earnings-call transcript or prepared remarks published on or before 2026-07-12 as a customer-official route distinct from GTC and SEC annual or quarterly filings.

Require the full official transcript to name both SK hynix and HBM when interpreting supply commitments, capacity agreements, booked periods, advance payments, or cancellation terms; do not promote snippets.

suggested_queries.rationale: The prior customer-official routes covered GTC, the FY2026 annual report, and a 2026 Form 10-Q, but not NVIDIA's May 2026 earnings-call transcript or prepared remarks. Review that distinct current customer communication only for explicit joint attribution to SK hynix and HBM, including a booked period, quantity, non-cancellable commitment, advance payment, or capacity agreement; generic HBM demand or NVIDIA-wide supply commentary does not resolve the objective.
